sets.description: Single-storey suburban ranch house across a lawn, low sun or moon behind, pines framing the edges.

params.pineDrift: number px the fg pines drift outward on push (default 70)

sets.description: Two-lane rural road seen from the shoulder: fields, hedges and telephone poles behind.
Dense woods at night: blurred trunks, a moon through the trees, ferns framing the bottom corners.
Night city sidewalk: brick storefronts with lit windows and a neon sign, skyline behind.
1970s living room: striped wallpaper, curtained window, framed picture, floor lamp glow. Blurred backdrop for waist/closeup shots.
Bare room: back door ajar with a moonlit gap, small window with the moon, dark floor. Pair with table/chair/lamp_hanging props.
Small 70s kitchen: tiled splashback, wall cabinets, window over the sink, counter, checkered floor.
Bare interview room: cinder-block wall, one-way mirror, steel door, bare bulb overhead, metal table.
Victorian parlour (horror classics, The Monkey's Paw): damask wallpaper, fireplace with live fire glow, oval portrait, heavy curtains.

Indian folklore: a jungle clearing — jewel sky (sun, crescent or full moon by time), layered patterned hills, a far treeline, an ochre clearing to stand in, a great patterned banyan on the right, ferns and grass framing the bottom.
Indian folklore: a village courtyard — thatched mud huts with Madhubani bands (doors glow after dark), a stone well with a pot, a rangoli on the beaten-earth ground, palms and a treeline behind.

Indian folklore: stone steps (ghat) down to a wide river — far bank with hills and treeline, boats rocking on the water, a small temple spire on the left, a domed chhatri on the right; floating diyas glow at dusk and night, the sun or moon reflects in the water.

Indian folklore: a village temple courtyard — a tall banded shikhara spire with a pennant, a pillared mandapa porch with a swinging bell, a sacred peepal tree on a platform tied with red threads, flagstone floor, diyas lit after dark.

Indian folklore / world: a Himalayan mountain pass — far snow-tipped ranges, nearer rocky slopes, a winding ochre path climbing to a notch, pines on either side and prayer flags fluttering across the path.
World / folklore: high snow-capped peaks above a snowfield — great white-capped mountains, snow-laden pines, soft snow drifts to stand on. Cold and quiet; pairs well with the fog fx.
Indian folklore / world: open farmland — rows of mustard (golden by day) running to the horizon, a hut and palms far off, hills behind, a dirt path in front to stand on.

Indian folklore / history: a Rajput palace hall — rose-red walls with cusped arch windows showing the sky outside (time of day), gilded pillars, a patterned marble floor, hanging brass lamps that glow at dusk and night.

Indian true crime/drama: the shared corridor of a Mumbai chawl — a row of numbered doors on a pastel wall, a clothesline of drying clothes overhead, steel buckets, tube lights glowing at night, a window to the street at one end.

Indian true crime/drama: an old colonial-era bungalow behind a compound wall — whitewashed walls, a red-tiled sloping roof, a pillared verandah, shuttered windows (lit at night), a gulmohar tree and a gravel driveway to stand on.

Indian drama/true crime: the inner courtyard of an old family haveli — faded ochre walls, a row of scalloped arches below a carved wooden balcony (jharokha), a heavy studded door, a tulsi planter in the middle of the stone floor. Lamps glow at night.

Indian true crime/drama: a busy city street (Mumbai/Delhi) — a row of small shops with rolling shutters and plain coloured signboards, a tea stall awning, tangled overhead wires, a street lamp (lit at night), apartment blocks behind, a pavement to stand on.

Indian true crime: a district police station (thana) — two-tone green-and-cream wall, a wooden desk piled with case files, a steel almirah, a notice board, a ceiling fan and tube light, a barred lockup on the right.

Indian true crime/drama: a district courtroom — dark wood panelling, the judge's raised bench in the middle under a wall clock, a witness box on the left, a wooden railing, ceiling fans, tall windows.

Indian true crime/drama: a newspaper newsroom — rows of desks with old monitors and typewriters, stacks of newspapers, a wall clock, pinned front pages on a board, windows onto the city (lit skyline at night).

Indian true crime/drama: a lonely village road — a dusty road running into flat fields, a white-and-yellow milestone, a lone neem tree, a roadside tea stall with a bench, electric poles receding into the distance. Moonlit at night.

packs.name: Indian folklore
packs.description: Village tales, jungle fables, river and temple legends, palace stories. Diorama style with the Gond/Madhubani folk-pattern skin; every set comes in day, dusk and night (setVariant.time).
motifs: jewel palette: indigo, peacock, marigold, vermilion

packs.name: Indian true crime + drama
packs.description: Everyday Indian places for true crime and family drama: chawl, bungalow, haveli, city street, police station, courtroom, newsroom, village road. Diorama style, muted and grounded (no folk patterns); every set comes in day and night (setVariant.time). Costumes: kurta, sari, dhoti, sherwani, police khaki, turban, veil, police cap.
motifs: red only as a tint at the turn

packs.name: Classic die-cut (true crime, horror)
packs.description: The original muted die-cut puppet style used by the true-crime and horror-classics series.
motifs: red only as a tint at the turn

Tumbler glass, half full.

props.description: Wooden kitchen chair, side-on, back on the left.
Ceiling lamp on a cord with a light cone. Responds to swing and flicker.
Standing floor lamp with fabric shade and warm glow. Responds to flicker.
Rotary telephone with handset.
Folded newspaper with masthead and a big headline (text param). Good with slam.
Instant photo with a hand-written caption (text param).
Clear evidence bag with red label strip.
Manila case folder with tab and typed label.
Old leather suitcase with handle and straps.
Paper luggage tag on a string (text param).
Hand-written letter, one page.
Sealed envelope with stamp.
Wall calendar page showing a month and day.
Round wall clock showing a time.
Wood-cabinet CRT television; the screen glows (responds to flicker).
Arched wooden table radio with dial.
Panelled interior door; opens with door_open (hinge on the left).
Sash window; pane colour = what is outside; lit windows glow (light).
Corkboard with photos, pins and red string (investigation board).
Pair of steel handcuffs.
Police badge (shield).
Old brass key.
A shrivelled monkey's paw with three curled fingers (The Monkey's Paw).
Rural mailbox on a post with a red flag.
Layered mountain pine; params.snow lays snow on each tier (diorama style).

props.description: Rounded bush.
Spiky grass tuft for foregrounds.
Cluster of fern fronds for foreground framing (flip leans them the other way).
Full moon with soft glow.
Low sun disc with warm glow.
Curved street lamp with a light pool. Responds to flicker.
White picket fence section.
Long-handled shovel, planted at a lean (blade buried).

props.description: Freshly dug mound of earth; withShovel plants a shovel in it.
Clay-and-brass hand lantern hanging from its handle; glows and flickers gently (folklore pack).
props.origin: top of the handle (hangs from a hand)

props.description: Bengal tiger in profile facing left, folk-patterned paper (folklore pack). head_turn/nod move the head, walk_in_place steps the legs, the tail sways by itself. Flip to face right.
props.origin: ground under the middle of the body

props.description: Indian elephant in profile facing left, wearing a patterned vermilion saddle cloth (jhool) and a gold forehead ornament; trunk and ears sway, tail swishes. head_turn/nod move the head, walk_in_place steps the legs.
props.origin: ground under the middle of the body

props.description: Zebu cow (white, humped) in profile facing left, painted horns and a marigold garland, patterned back cloth; tail swishes. head_turn/nod move the head, walk_in_place steps the legs.
props.origin: ground under the middle of the body

props.description: Peacock facing left; train trailing on the ground, or fanned open behind it with eye-spots (params.fan: true) and shivering. The head bobs; head_turn/nod work.
Gond-patterned owl sitting upright, big gold eyes that blink now and then; head_turn swivels the head. Put it on a branch or wall top (origin = its feet).
Black crow standing, facing left; hops and caws (beak opens) every couple of seconds. An omen in folklore.
Cobra coiled on the ground with its hood raised, swaying slowly, tongue flicking; spectacle mark on the hood.
A loose V of small dark birds flapping and drifting left across the sky. Place high in the frame on the mid layer.
props.origin: centre of the flock at t=0

props.description: Indian street dog (pariah) in profile facing left: lean, tan, curled tail that wags, pricked ears. head_turn/nod move the head, walk_in_place steps the legs.
props.origin: ground under the middle of the body

props.description: Horse in profile facing left, dark mane, patterned saddle cloth (params.saddle: false to remove), swishing tail. head_turn/nod move the head, walk_in_place steps the legs.
props.origin: ground under the middle of the body

props.description: Folk round tree (peepal/mango): trunk and a scalloped canopy with a dotted Gond edge (diorama style).

actions.description: Eyes close for the action window (use dur ≈ 0.07).
Head rotates from one angle to another and holds.
Head tilts to an angle and holds.
Head dips down and up `count` times.
Head shakes side to side, decaying.
Head lifts and eyes look up, and holds.
Switch to another expression at `at`.
Both arms sway gently (idle life).
One arm raises and waves an open hand.
Hitchhiker thumb arm bobs during the window, then lowers.
One arm raises to point; holds.
Both forearms lift with open palms (offering / pleading); holds.
Legs and arms alternate in stop-motion steps with a body bob.
Slides in from the left edge, easing out.
Slides out past the left edge, easing in.
Slides in from the right edge, easing out.
Slides out past the right edge, easing in.
Vehicle drives in from fromX to its placement x, wheels spinning.
Vehicle accelerates away to toX.
Topples about its base corner with a bounce.
Pendulum swing about the hang point (hanging lamps, signs).
Light flickers during the window, then settles dim.
Door swings open; holds.
Door swings shut; holds.
Drops in from above and lands with a bounce (newspapers, files). Pair with a camera shake.
Scales up from nothing with overshoot.
Gentle bob up and down.
Fine nervous shaking.
Camera shake, decaying (target "camera").
